description: M4-04 clean macOS ARM64 source checkout, README command execution and temporary user installation.
documentation_overlay: Working-tree README, CONTRIBUTING and README verifier for M4-04; application/platform build sources remain at f05f326.
initial_state: No generated platform, project cache or dist outputs in the fresh remote branch clone.
prerequisites: Preinstalled exact Roc and Rust; RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable resolves to Rust 1.99.0, enforced by bootstrap. Cargo registry and external HTTP package cache reused.
source_build: Actual README build block downloads/verifies both pinned archives, rebuilds the host and compiles the optimized CLI.

default_clone.reason: scripts/build_platform.py absent on the default branch

cases.name: user-install
cases.script:
JLOG_INSTALL_PREFIX="${JLOG_INSTALL_PREFIX:-$HOME/.local}"
mkdir -p "$JLOG_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
install -m 755 dist/jlog "$JLOG_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/jlog"
export PATH="$JLOG_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin:$PATH"
jlog --version

cases.name: installed-without-toolchain-on-path
cases.script:
if command -v roc >/dev/null || command -v rustc >/dev/null; then exit 99; fi
jlog --version
jlog --help
printf '%s\n' '{"status":"failed"}' '{"status":"ok"}' | jlog --where status=failed | jlog --count

source_checks.name: build
source_checks.script:
roc version
# Expected: Roc compiler version nightly-2026-10-09-258ab27

python3 scripts/build_platform.py

mkdir -p dist
roc build --opt=speed --no-cache --output=dist/jlog src/main.roc
./dist/jlog --version

source_checks.name: run-check-format
source_checks.script:
python3 scripts/build_platform.py
roc run src/main.roc -- --help
roc check src/main.roc
roc fmt --check src/main.roc src/Cli.roc src/Jsonl.roc src/Operations.roc

source_checks.name: dev-and-speed-regressions
source_checks.script:
python3 scripts/build_platform.py
mkdir -p dist

# Development mode
roc test --opt=dev --no-cache src/main.roc
roc build --opt=dev --no-cache --output=dist/jlog src/main.roc
JLOG_BIN="$PWD/dist/jlog" python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

# Optimized mode: repeat executable tests against this new build
roc test --opt=speed --no-cache src/main.roc
roc build --opt=speed --no-cache --output=dist/jlog src/main.roc
JLOG_BIN="$PWD/dist/jlog" python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

scope: Source and user-prefix installation; no release archive or minimum-OS certification.
